title: Dynamic Pressure Formula
text: Use the relation between dynamic pressure and the square of velocity: $$p=\tfrac12\rho{}v**2,$$ where $$p$$ is the dynamic pressure, $$\rho$$ is the density of the fluid, and $$v$$ is the speed of the fluid.

title: Relate the Two Pressure Readings
text: Since the altitude (and thus the air density $$\rho)$$ remains constant, the ratio of the pressures equals the square of the ratio of the speeds: $$\frac{p_{2}}{p_{1}}=\left(\frac{v_{2}}{v_{1}}\right)**2$$.
